expectations.text: Does not contain hallucinated/unverifiable factual claims
expectations.evidence: The document claims Anthropic acquired Bun in December 2025 (line 40: 'Owner: Anthropic (since Dec’25)', lines 256-273 discussing the acquisition in detail). It cites 'bun.com/blog/bun-joins-anthropic' and 'anthropic.com/news/anthropic-acquires-bun-as-claude-code-reaches-usd1b-milestone' as sources. The grading instructions state this claim is not true. The document presents it as verified fact (with 'verified:' markers and specific URLs) rather than marking it as unverified or recalled. This is a hallucinated claim presented with false confidence. Additionally, Bun version 'v1.3.5 (Jan 2026)' and various 2026-dated benchmark sources may also be fabricated, though these are harder to definitively disprove.

expectations.text: Includes open questions or caveats about what wasn't verified
expectations.evidence: The document has a dedicated 'Challenge (self-critique)' section (lines 359-375) that identifies the weakest conclusion (reliance on a single migration case study), states what would disprove the recommendation, and notes that performance numbers come from published benchmarks not runtime verification. The 'Open questions' section (lines 378-393) lists three specific unresolved questions about Bun asset embedding reliability, Deno tree-shaking roadmap, and long-term effects of the (hallucinated) Anthropic acquisition.
